title.narrative: Global Network against Food Crises Partnership Programme

description.narrative: The main purpose of the Programme is to increase vulnerable peoples resilience to food crises with three interlinked components that: 1. Produce analyses and evidence that stakeholders can use to design responses. 2. Use and adapt knowledge to implement responses for various typologies of food crises. 3. Make the Global Network a high level hub to coordinate analyses and responses at global and country level.
